runtimeSynthesis: seamless stationary orthogonal weave; 32 px per thread pitch; alternating over/under crossings; periodic yarn waviness and width microvariation
sourceScaleMethod: estimated from 0.56 mm published fabric thickness plus visible density; portal swatches contain no ruler

alphaDerivation: continuous reconstructed warp/weft coverage; Alpha is the complement of the real inter-yarn spaces; 3% was used only to calibrate yarn width after topology existed
normalDerivation: height gradient of continuous rounded yarns with alternating over/under crossings
roughnessDerivation: shared technical-screen response modulated by reconstructed yarn height
